import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s1=np.sqrt(1+t); s0=np.sqrt(t)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3
            + s1*(p[4]+p[5]*np.sqrt(P)+p[6]*P)
            + s0*(p[7]*P+p[8]*P**2+p[9]*P*np.log(P)))
